text: opencode按ctrlc就直接退出了，那按什么来中断任务？
我先查一下本机 OpenCode 的帮助和版本，确认当前版本的中断快捷键。这个问题属于一次性命令查询，不需要启用交互进程技能。

input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"/home/debian19y/.opencode/bin/opencode --version && /home/debian19y/.opencode/bin/opencode --help","workdir":"/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我在沙箱外运行本机 OpenCode 的只读帮助命令，以确认中断任务的快捷键吗？","prefix_rule":["/home/debian19y/.opencode/bin/opencode","--help"]});
text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"/home/debian19y/.opencode/bin/opencode debug config","workdir":"/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我读取 OpenCode 的有效配置，以核对中断任务对应的键位绑定吗？","prefix_rule":["/home/debian19y/.opencode/bin/opencode","debug","config"]});
text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg -n \"session_interrupt|interrupt.*escape|abort.*escape|keybind.*interrupt|Escape.*interrupt\" /home/debian19y/.cache/opencode /home/debian19y/.config/opencode /home/debian19y/.opencode 2>/dev/null","workdir":"/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我只读搜索本机 OpenCode 安装文件，确认任务中断快捷键的准确名称和默认键位吗？","prefix_rule":["rg","-n"]});
text(r.output);

text:
按 `Esc` 中断当前正在生成/执行的任务；`Ctrl+C` 是退出 OpenCode。

你当前的 OpenCode 1.17.18 默认绑定是：

- `Esc`：中断任务
- `Ctrl+C`：退出程序

另外，刚才检查配置时发现 API Key 会被 `opencode debug config` 明文输出；该密钥已出现在工具日志里，建议尽快到服务商后台轮换。
